content.short: Bright Union is a DeFi insurance marketplace that aggregates and compares DeFi insurance protocols.
content.description: The web3.0 economy is full of liabilities. Multiple insurance products for crypto assets have launched. Smart contract coverages now protect holders of crypto against exploits based on bugs in the code, de-pegging, or rug pulls. The swift rise of multiple parties offering these products provides an opportunity for a single platform to aggregate and match supply and demand, accelerating the industry by providing strongly needed insurance liquidity.
content.meta: Bright Union is a DeFi insurance market that aggregates and compares insurance protocols. Discover Bright Union and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
